ADR-0048 §3.4 cross-package coexistence does not reach jobs: a job is scheduled by its bare name (app-artifact-handlers.ts 「⛔ Nothing here resolves a bare name to a package: a job is scheduled by its」). Route by SKILL.md 元判据 ②: two implementations of one judgment disagree (install door and binder refuse, composition accepts) ⇒ the governed refusal wins, so composition refuses with the binder's reading. Ruling A does not itself cover two different packages; extending the refusal to two bodies follows ②, not ruling A. Card to-do 1 (where the clash is judged) is answered here by ②, at composition.
